operations.title: WP40: the descended u-class charge has the closed form q_u = C*y_t^2*|V_cb|*sin(gamma_CKM) with C = 0.9993729706 universal - bulk max deviation 2.3e-11 over all 232 u-anchor sheets; found by the 10-dim physical refit-gradient (y_t +2.0010, Vcb +0.9978, Vub -0.9993, gamma +0.4790 = gamma*cot gamma, lstsq resid 6.3e-5); texture-independent (theta-half-split 4.6e-10, corr -0.058); falsified candidates stay falsified (yt^2 Vtd/Vus dev 3.6e-4); the u-anchor weak charge is y_t^2 times the CKM unitarity-triangle height - a chart quantity equal on the fitted locus to a monomial of weak-basis invariants; concrete H2LR pairing component (ledger 1983)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP40 - the descended charge is y_t^2 |V_cb| sin(gamma): chart loop data equals a physical monomial
operations.body: WP40 (ledger 1983, results/wp40_charge_closed_form.json, 5/5 gates) closes the form of the function F whose existence WP39 proved. q_u = C*y_t^2*|V_cb|*sin(gamma), C = 0.9993729706 universal, bulk deviation 2.3e-11 over 232 sheets. The gradient was measured directly: refitting one sheet against 17 shifted targets and solving the 10-dim physical response gives partials y_t +2.001, Vcb +0.998, Vub -0.999, gamma +0.4790 = gamma*cot(gamma) - i.e. sin(gamma), nothing else. Reading: the sparse chart's loop-holonomy charge is y_t^2 times the CKM unitarity-triangle height. For H2LR this is the sharpest flavor pairing yet: (edge data, loop holonomy) paired against weak-basis invariants through a monomial. WP11 is untouched - phi is still chart data; the equality holds on the fitted locus. Open: C = 1-6.27e-4 (universal, not a gamma-convention artifact), the c/t-anchor analogs, F_u/F_c = 11.155.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP40 - closed form of the descended flavor charge
operations.body: WP40 (ledger 1983): the WP39 descent function is a monomial - q_u = C*y_t^2*|V_cb|*sin(gamma) with C = 0.9993729706, verified at 2.3e-11 across the ensemble. Method note that may travel: ensemble log-log regression was uselessly collinear (resid 7.6e-13, smeared exponents); the decisive instrument was refit-response - perturb the physical targets, refit the chart, solve the small response problem for the gradient. That isolates physical-coordinate dependence from chart degeneracy and may be useful wherever a chart coordinate is suspected of secretly descending. The residual C = 1-6.27e-4 is universal and unexplained; it is the same under four normalization conventions, so it is physics or a systematic of the fitting convention, not a parametrization artifact.
